search_limits.result: No accessible SKU-specific used listing with verifiable asking price found; do not infer no secondary market exists.
Public thread read via browser; hundred-dollar comment refers to one pneumatic muscle, not complete hand. Excluded from hand price range.
Direct item blank; search-only ¥22200 lead. Other ¥999 explicitly deposit/preorder. ¥879 unknown option, not whole hand price.
No verified public listing in focused indexed search; private login not attempted.
Generic secondary-market guide; price on request, no verified used unit or transaction.

critical_boundaries: Published asking prices are not成交价 or landed cost.
No per-hand quantities inferred from finger-DoF specifications alone.
Domestic Inspire CMO-series prices cannot be assigned to RH56DFX exact SKU without quote.
Dex5-S is not Dex5-1/P; DG-5F legacy is not DG-5F-S; V5 is not V5 Plus.
No real Mac capacitive compatibility has been tested.
public_export_note: Raw third-party source snapshots remain private. Basenames/checksums identify audited snapshots, not files distributed in this repository.
